items.signal_prefix: Manufacturing footprint (deck milestones, not dated in the deck)

set.signal: Manufacturing footprint (deck milestones, not dated in the deck): plants in Taiwan, the USA and Malaysia. The Changxing II factory was officially opened, significantly enhancing server system assembly capabilities, and server system integration reached L11 capabilities; the company completed the construction of a U.S. system assembly factory, its Malaysia factory is under construction, and the deck lists a Production Capacity Doubling Plan. It also added system assembly lines specifically for its growing IPC business.

items.reason: This entry carries the supply_status slot dated 05-26-2026, so it should hold only capacity facts. The In Shin land repurchase agreement with the Jiangsu government is an undated historical milestone (listed among older items such as the 30th-anniversary event and the WINBOT launch), a land transaction rather than a capacity fact; dropped. The remaining capacity facts are verbatim and keep the 'not dated in the deck' hedge; slot kept because the Malaysia build and the Capacity Doubling Plan are stated as current.
